decisions.decision: Rev. 8 reorganization: both phases get orchestrators, main.go simplified to 2 calls
decisions.rationale: hostPhase/host_phase.go orchestrates MountVirtualFilesystems + BootstrapAlpine + PrepareChrootEnv + InjectApkHooks. chrootPhase/chroot_phase.go orchestrates 14 steps. main.go reduced to hostPhase.Run(conf) + chrootPhase.Run(conf).

decisions.decision: Removed enableEncryption flag
decisions.rationale: Flag was defined but never checked (LUKS always applied). Bug fix, separate from reorg.

decisions.decision: Unified ExecuteCmd function replaces RunCommand/RunChrootCommand/WriteFileInChroot
decisions.rationale: Single entry point for all command execution with retry, logging, and user feedback. Matches old bash installer behavior. No backward compatibility.

decisions.decision: File writes via shell commands (echo/cat) instead of direct file writes
decisions.rationale: Matches old bash installer behavior. All operations go through ExecuteCmd for consistent logging and retry logic.

decisions.decision: Modules moved to packageLogic instead of hardcoded in services.go
decisions.rationale: Booster doesn't use /etc/modules. Modules tied to packages belong in packageLogic. Kernel-only modules (r8169, bonding, binfmt_misc, zsmalloc) stay in baseModules.

decisions.decision: incus-feature-vm only needs qemu-system-x86_64
decisions.rationale: incus-feature-vm is for VM management. Its only dependency is qemu. Groups and modules come from qemu-system-x86_64's own packageLogic.

decisions.decision: kvm module instead of kvm-amd/kvm-intel
decisions.rationale: Alpine kernel uses generic kvm module, not vendor-specific kvm-amd/kvm-intel.

decisions.decision: Vector socket path: /run/vector/syslog.sock (not /dev/log)
decisions.rationale: Vector user can't create socket in /dev (root-owned). /run/ is tmpfs, writable by all. Symlink /dev/log → /run/vector/syslog.sock for compatibility.

decisions.decision: vector-setup service in boot stage (not sysinit)
decisions.rationale: /var/log is btrfs subvolume mounted by localmount in boot stage. vector-setup needs /var/log for chown.

decisions.decision: vector-setup: chown /var/log without -R flag
decisions.rationale: Files created by Vector are already owned by vector user. Only directory ownership needed. Much faster than recursive chown.

decisions.decision: Vector config written AFTER package install
decisions.rationale: apk add vector overwrites /etc/vector/vector.yaml with demo_logs placeholder. Config must be written after install.

decisions.decision: Vector check: apk info | grep -q '^vector$'
decisions.rationale: Init-system agnostic, works with OpenRC and future dinit. Better than checking /etc/init.d/vector.

decisions.decision: internal_rules.yaml: only base OS in defaultRunlevels
decisions.rationale: Services moved to packageLogic. defaultRunlevels only contains kernel/OS services.

decisions.decision: udev services in packageLogic under eudev
decisions.rationale: Alpine uses mdev by default. udev services only needed when eudev is installed.

decisions.decision: modules service removed from boot runlevel
decisions.rationale: booster loads /etc/modules automatically. modules service not needed with booster.

decisions.decision: btrbk snapshot_dir: /btrbk/snapshots (not /mnt/btrbk/snapshots)
decisions.rationale: Correct path for btrfs subvolume mount point.

decisions.decision: Vector VRL syntax: parse_syslog() ?? {} fallback
decisions.rationale: parse_syslog() is fallible, needs error handling. Added ?? {} fallback for unparseable messages.

decisions.decision: rsyslog/logrotate replaced with vector (Rust)
decisions.rationale: Memory-safe logging pipeline. Vector 0.55.0 in Alpine edge/community.

decisions.decision: Package masking removed from installer
decisions.rationale: Alpine apk masking via /etc/apk/world conflicts with explicit package dependencies.

decisions.decision: zram-init removed, replaced with zswap + swap file
decisions.rationale: zswap is kernel feature for compressed swap cache. More flexible than zram.

decisions.decision: Test artifacts: tests/artifacts/<tool-name>/<timestamp>/
decisions.rationale: All test outputs go to tests/artifacts/<tool-name>/<timestamp>/.

decisions.decision: Harness writes variables.yaml directly instead of stdin
decisions.rationale: Replaced writeHarnessSetupInput + writeHarnessRuntimeOverrides with writeHarnessVariables.

decisions.decision: Clevis TPM2 bind policy: {} (no PCR policy, TPM identity only)
decisions.rationale: PCR7 mismatch between bind time and boot time in QEMU/OVMF caused sealed keys to fail.

decisions.decision: LUKS keyfile embedded in initramfs for auto-unlock
decisions.rationale: booster waits for interactive passphrase in QEMU headless — keyfile in initramfs enables automatic unlock.

decisions.decision: booster instead of mkinitfs for initramfs
decisions.rationale: booster is faster, simpler, and supports LUKS2 natively

decisions.decision: Signed UKI instead of GRUB
decisions.rationale: Unified Kernel Image enables Secure Boot without GRUB complexity

decisions.decision: Btrfs RAID1 on LUKS (not mdadm)
decisions.rationale: Btrfs native RAID1 is simpler and more reliable than mdadm

decisions.decision: Ripgrep NOT used as grep drop-in replacement
decisions.rationale: rg doesn't support GNU regex extensions (\+). efi-mkuki uses grep with \+ for kernel version validation. Symlink grep→rg breaks UKI build.

decisions.decision: Aliases removed from misc.go
decisions.rationale: Shell aliases (ll, nano, rm -i, apk --progress, untar, mv -v) removed. Some handled by dummy packages, others simply removed.

decisions.decision: GNU grep removed, using BusyBox grep
decisions.rationale: GNU grep has zero reverse dependencies. BusyBox grep provides POSIX BRE (supports \+). Saves package space.

decisions.decision: @swap skips 'btrfs property set compression none' (NoCompressionProp field)
decisions.rationale: The compression property sets the 'm' attribute on every file, which makes chattr +C fail ('cannot set NOCOW flag: Invalid argument' from mkswapfile). Documented in NixOS/nixpkgs #384047. Debian guide: chattr +C on the @swap directory before mount, then btrfs filesystem mkswapfile. btrfsStandardServer keeps dedicated LUKS swap partitions (no swapfile).

decisions.decision: Removed 'btrfs property set compression none' from ALL NoCoW subvolumes (Option A)
decisions.rationale: The 'm' attribute set by the compression property conflicts with chattr +C on every file (NixOS/nixpkgs #384047). NODATACOW implies no compression (btrfs docs), so the property is redundant. chattr +C on the subvolume directory is the only mechanism needed. NoCompressionProp field removed. Verified by new harness check lsattr_nocow: all 7 NoCoW subvolumes have C, no m, compressed subvolumes stay CoW. 29/29 checks pass.

decisions.decision: swap service moved to boot runlevel + 'before localmount' → 'need localmount' via sed in SetupServices
decisions.rationale: OpenRC upstream swap.initd has 'before localmount' which guarantees start order only, NOT stop order (service-script-guide: 'on calling stop the two are independent'). At shutdown localmount unmounted /swap while swapfile still active ('in use but fuser finds nothing' — fuser can't see swapfiles). 'need localmount' = hard dependency: start after localmount, stop BEFORE localmount. Moving swap to boot alone would break start (swapon -a before /swap mounted, eend 0 hides failure). btrfs-scan (before localmount) verified: no broken dependency. apk preserves modified /etc files as .apk-new (verified in Alpine docs) — the sed survives openrc upgrades, no re-apply needed.

decisions.decision: Harness services_status check verifies services are actually started (rc-status --all), excluding QEMU-only services
decisions.rationale: [ ok ] at boot is not proof a service runs: smartd shows 'start-stop-daemon: no matching processes found' (no SMART hardware in QEMU — daemon crashes), fsck shows 'fsck.vfat: No such file or directory' (fsck.vfat not installed — ESP check fails silently). New check verifies 32 configured services are 'started' via rc-status --all, excludes smartd/fsck/udev-settle (cannot work under QEMU), parses supervise-daemon format '[ started 00:00:36 (0) ]'. log_errors whitelist extended for both false positives.

decisions.decision: niri desktop: data in internal_rules (nixPackages field) + config logic in chrootPhase/desktops/niri.go
decisions.rationale: kde/gnome are pure data (packages/services/groups) — stay in internal_rules. niri needs configs (greetd, regreet, niri configs, wayvnc, xdg-su, dms service) — chrootPhase/desktops/niri.go, same pattern as features/. nixPackages field behaves like apk: data selects install, auto-enables Nix. DMS + quickshell from stable nixpkgs channel (nixos-26.05) — dms-shell is packaged in nixpkgs, no external flake.

decisions.decision: nix sandbox disabled only for chroot install (--option sandbox false), not in nix.conf
decisions.rationale: The nix build sandbox uses pivot_root which fails inside the installer chroot (EINVAL — / is not a mountpoint). trusted-users = root @wheel in nix.conf so the flag is honored (was ignored: 'not a trusted user'). The installed system keeps the default sandbox. TMPDIR=/nix/var/nix/build/tmp on the @nix-var-nix-build subvolume (permanent via profile.d) — /tmp is noexec+0755 for security.

decisions.decision: elogind as seat provider (not seatd); render group removed; turnstile removed
decisions.rationale: greetd crashed because libseat had no backend — elogind provides logind via D-Bus (starts after dbus, before greetd). render group does not exist on Alpine (video covers DRM access). turnstile is edge-only, not in Alpine 3.24 — removed with comment to include when stable.

decisions.decision: NIXPKGS_ALLOW_* env vars (not nix.conf allow-unfree/allow-insecure) for unfree/insecure packages
decisions.rationale: allow-unfree/allow-insecure are NOT recognized by Alpine's nix build (unknown setting warnings on every nix command). The NIXPKGS_ALLOW_INSECURE/NIXPKGS_ALLOW_UNFREE env vars in /etc/profile.d/nix-daemon.sh + fish/bash are the working mechanism and are permanent. TMPDIR=/nix/var/nix/build/tmp also permanent via profile.d (not a nix.conf option).

decisions.decision: sudoers @includedir enabled (sed in misc.go)
decisions.rationale: Alpine's default /etc/sudoers has '@includedir /etc/sudoers.d' commented out, so /etc/sudoers.d/wheel (%wheel ALL=(ALL) ALL) was never loaded — wheel sudo denied. Enabled with sed; verified by new sudoers_includedir harness check (37/37 PASS).

decisions.decision: fstab swap entries use /dev/mapper/swap-* (not LABEL=swap-*)
decisions.rationale: busybox swapon -a does NOT resolve LABEL=/UUID= in fstab — it reads the device field as a literal path. LABEL=swap-vdb3 never resolves to /dev/disk/by-label/swap-vdb3 → 'No such file or directory'. dmcrypt opens real /dev/mapper/swap-* nodes, so swapon opens those paths directly. Pre-existing bug (old swap_status check was non-truthful).

decisions.decision: dmcrypt swap keyfile written directly in chroot (no /tmp + copy)
decisions.rationale: The swap LUKS partitions stay open (mappers active) until the end of RunBtrfsSetup, so luksAddKey can run after the subvolumes are mounted. Step 8a creates the keyfile directly at /mnt/etc/dmcrypt/swap.key (dd + chmod 400), runs luksAddKey ×2, then writes /etc/conf.d/dmcrypt. Simpler than /tmp + install copy. apk never overwrites new files (saves as .apk-new).

decisions.decision: enableSwapfile → enableSwap (generic) + swapSize variable (default auto = 2x RAM)
decisions.rationale: btrfsStandard keeps swapfile, btrfsRaid0 uses 2 LUKS swap partitions (partition 2, swapSize/2 each), btrfsStandardServer unchanged (always LUKS swap — user-confirmed hard requirement). swapSize = TOTAL swap size split across partitions; auto = 2x RAM via /proc/meminfo MemTotal. Resolved by utils/swap.ResolveSwapSizeMiB. swap service conditional on enableSwap (fixes latent bug: swap never activated on RAID0).

decisions.decision: btrfsRaid0: swap on partition 2, root on partition 3 (remainder)
decisions.rationale: User chose: swap partition is number 2, root takes the remainder (no size formulas — respects the original RAID0 requirement). swapSize total split across the 2 swap partitions. Without swap: 1: EFI, 2: root (as before).

decisions.decision: AGENTS.md compression: pointer-only structure, history → CHANGELOG
decisions.rationale: AGENTS.md 596→145 lines (<250 target). Project Structure moved to docs/INSTALLER.md#project-structure, history truncated to last 2 entries with pointer to CHANGELOG + .agent-memory + git log. Preserved Build & Test verbatim for agents.

decisions.decision: Pre-commit hook vet+lint on staged Go files only
decisions.rationale: Hook detects staged *.go via git diff --cached, runs go vet ./... per package (src vs harness), then golangci-lint with fallback $HOME/go/bin/golangci-lint, skip if missing. Fixed grep -- leading dash bug for -----BEGIN pattern. Set core.hooksPath=.githooks.

decisions.decision: Fixtures library Tier1/2/3 split for CI cost
decisions.rationale: 14 templates cover all use cases without 384-combo explosion. Tier1 CI gate minimal+noswap per layout (2h), Tier2 nightly explicit+isolate (4h), Tier3 manual full. Validated critical gap btrfsRaid0-noswap 32/32 and explicit 8G both layouts 32/32.

decisions.decision: dinit services dir = /lib/dinit.d (Option B, Alpine standard) — NOT /usr/lib/dinit.d
decisions.rationale: Stock Alpine dinit 0.21 system-init scan list (source-verified options-processing.cc build_paths): /etc/dinit.d, /run/dinit.d, /usr/local/lib/dinit.d, /lib/dinit.d. /usr/lib/dinit.d absent — Chimera works only because cports patches their dinit. dinit-chimera APKBUILD prepare() seds meson srvdir='/lib/dinit.d' (meson / operator: absolute RHS discards prefix → EARLY_PATH/HELPER_PATH/SCRIPT_PATH coherent; tmpfdir/dlibdir libdir-relative, unaffected). Plain mv NOT safe (paths compiled into scripts). Bonus: dinitctl also finds services (stock scan list). CI smoke had masked the bug with explicit -d flag.

decisions.decision: defaultRunlevelsDinit emptied; getty enablement owned by getty-dinit package; dinitReplacedByChimera skip-list for -openrc→-dinit conversion
decisions.rationale: getty-dinit already ships boot.d/getty@tty1+getty@ttyS0; installer's plain 'getty' link loaded a template file as non-template service where $1 is NOT expanded → agetty no args → restart flap loop. 9 -openrc bases (agetty, busybox, cryptsetup, eudev, incus-feature, kbd, makedumpfile, udev-init-scripts, util-linux) are permanently covered by the dinit-chimera suite — skip-list in internal_rules.yaml (data-driven) instead of warning noise + wasted retries; missing -dinit detected via output parse ('no such package') since SKEA_NONINTERACTIVE swallows the error.

decisions.decision: Init-aware target shutdown in harness: enableDinit → /usr/sbin/dinit-poweroff; OpenRC → poweroff; no force quit; bounded 5m wait that fails the run instead of hanging
decisions.rationale: BusyBox poweroff sends SIGUSR2 which dinit ignores (only SIGINT=reboot/SIGTERM=halt/SIGQUIT=immediate); dinitctl shutdown sends HALT (QEMU stays); dinit-poweroff asks the daemon to roll back services then execs /usr/sbin/dinit-shutdown --system -p (reboot(RB_POWER_OFF)). The daemon needs the dinit-shutdown package to finalize ANY shutdown — added to installer corePkgs; conventional /usr/bin commands wired (poweroff/halt/shutdown symlinks + reboot/soft-reboot wrappers — invocation-name detection needs the dinit- prefix). Verified: dinit 48/48 (2m41s), OpenRC 39/39 (2m32s), live debug_run reboot/poweroff test.

decisions.decision: Milestone/history log lives in CHANGELOG.md (## Milestone Log section, newest first) — AGENTS.md no longer carries the dated history section
decisions.rationale: AGENTS.md keeps project context only and ends at Known Issues; dated implementation entries go to CHANGELOG.md. Future session entries append to the CHANGELOG Milestone Log section. handoff/latest.md 'Milestone log' pointer updated.

decisions.decision: Harness verify checks MUST be falsifiable: fail with non-zero exit, never a bare '|| echo <fail>' fallback
decisions.rationale: Verify marks PASS on SSH exit code 0 (Pass: err == nil) — 'A && echo ok || echo fail' always exits 0, so the check can never go red (false green; 8 dinit_* checks affected). Fixes also corrected 3 commands: busybox ps has no -p (→ /proc/1/comm), bare dinitctl status is a usage error (→ dinitctl list), keyring installs the repo at /etc/apk/repositories.d/feralos.list (check grepped /etc/apk/repositories). All dinit checks now 'COND && echo <ok> || { echo <fail>; exit 1; }'; verified 48/48 (run 2026-09-24T23-42-02Z).

decisions.decision: dinit shutdown ordering enforced via stop-command guards: dbus/elogind wait (bounded) for turnstiled exit before stopping
decisions.rationale: dinit 0.21 releases a dependency when dependents begin stopping (release_dependencies on prop_release) — depends-on cannot express stop-after-dependent-exit (source-verified + local repro: dependency TERM'd 3.7s before dependent finished). stop-command runs INSTEAD of the process signal: scripts wait bounded for turnstiled (pidof — Alpine busybox pgrep has no -x) then stop the daemon (TERM->KILL); stop-timeout=30 failsafe; no-op without turnstile. Rejected: allowlist (masks regressions), log-type=file (hides), wrappers (partial coverage). ADR-007.

decisions.decision: All -dinit services ship /etc/dinit.d/config/<svc>.conf via the Artix wrapper pattern (service -> /usr/lib/dinit/<svc> wrapper -> source config -> exec daemon ${VARS})
decisions.rationale: OpenRC services shipped /etc/conf.d/<svc> sourced by init scripts (52 conf.d files inventoried via confd_dump); the dinit conversion hardcoded flags in service files — no user customization point, edits lost on apk upgrade. Wrapper+config restores the convention: 644 apk-protected config (edits survive, new version lands as .apk-new), defaults match Alpine conf.d, empty placeholder still shipped as customization point. Scripted services (cpufrequtils, iptables, nftables, klogd) use the same pattern. dnsmasq DNSMASQ_CFGFILE defaults to /etc/dnsmasq.conf (empty would mean no config at all). ADR-008.

decisions.decision: dinit service conventions = Artix/Chimera alignment: no restart on daemons (smooth-recovery only; getty exception), restart=false explicit on scripted one-shots, before=login.target convention, network ordering chain (pre-network before network.target, firewalls before pre-network), dbus smooth-recovery=no, bus-name readiness via dbus-wait-for where daemon registers on bus, one-shots scripted not process; ADR-008 wrapper+config retained as FeralOS extension
decisions.rationale: Exhaustive audit (Artix gitea 7370 repos + 18768-pkg binary repo, Chimera cports + dinit-chimera) showed drift: restart=true could flap-loop/mask crashes, no login.target ordering, firewall race window, dnsmasq as root, getty hardcoded, lxc latent restart loop (process+restart=true on one-shot). Artix/Chimera never restart daemons, put login.target on every session-facing service, dbus-activate polkit/udisks2/fwupd (no init service). dbus-wait-for-dinit (BSD-2-Clause from dinit-rc, pipefd:4) gives bluez/elogind bus-name readiness. Verified 74/74 dinit niri + 49/49 OpenRC minimal. ADR-009.

decisions.decision: less ships as aports package less-dummy (wrapper script, provides=less=999 + replaces=less) instead of runtime mkpkg symlink less->bat; CI pulls alpine from public.ecr.aws mirror
decisions.rationale: Symlink was fundamentally broken: bat execs its HARDCODED pager 'less -R -F -K --no-init' on TTY (ignores $PAGER, only cat short-circuits) — symlink made bat re-exec itself, clap errored 'unexpected argument -R' (fish history/git log/man broken). Wrapper drops all less flags and dumps via 'bat --paging=never' — child never re-pages, chain terminates; file conflict with real less = C pager can never return. aports packaging = signed/versioned/CI-tested + pluggable content (future moar/ov Go pager, zero installer change) — matches 'standard core, pluggable data'. ECR public mirror = no Docker Hub anonymous pull rate limit (blocked 3 CI runs).

risks.risk: NVMe disk naming varies across hardware
risks.mitigation: Use blockdev for size detection, fdisk for partitioning

risks.risk: Nix integration may conflict with APK
risks.mitigation: Use separate /nix prefix, avoid PATH conflicts
LUKS keyfile auto-unlock, console=ttyS0,115200, per-device keyfile args

risks.risk: btrfs swapfile swapon fails on kernel 6.18
risks.mitigation: Root cause: 'btrfs property set compression none' sets 'm' attribute conflicting with chattr +C (NixOS/nixpkgs #384047). Fixed: @swap skips compression property, chattr +C on dir before mount, btrfs filesystem mkswapfile. 28/28 checks pass, swapon [ok] at boot.

risks.risk: apk upgrade of openrc and the sed on /etc/init.d/swap
risks.mitigation: apk preserves modified /etc files as .apk-new (verified in Alpine docs: 'Whenever apk wants to install a file, but realizes a potentially edited one is already present, it will write its file to that filename with .apk-new appended'). /etc/init.d/swap is protected — the sed survives upgrades, no re-apply needed.

risks.decision: dinit logging: daemon stderr to /var/log/dinit/<name>.log (log-type=file), PID1 trail via dinit_log_file=/run/dinit-boot.log mirrored by dinit-boot-log; logrotate re-added (supersedes 'vector replaces logrotate' — vector only TAILS rotated files)
risks.rationale: dinit default log-type=none discards stderr (no logs at all); /var/log mounts after dinit starts so the trail starts in /run and dinit-boot-log (aports pkg) mirrors it with cp + tail -F; rotation = logrotate copytruncate + delaycompress (vector-docs recommended), runs via /etc/periodic/daily (cronie), init-agnostic.

risks.decision: harness: hard 7-minute run limit (runHardTimeout, non-configurable) + 5-minute boot wait + runner instant kill with guest sync + swtpm restart race fix + --keep-target-running respected by watchdog
risks.rationale: runs that hang must die deterministically; graceful runner poweroff hung inside the budget; instant kill exposed the swtpm NVRAM lock race (fixed) and ESP vfat lost late writes (fixed with guest sync); 7m fits install + target boot + separate verify (verify command runs against the kept-alive target).
